title: Introduce prefill-conductor heuristic mapper and tenant defaults estimator
author: Asha Menon
description: Adds a prefill-conductor heuristic mapper service and a tenant defaults estimator that synthesizes batching, cache, and quantization profiles from telemetry signatures. Motivation: many tenants have predictable temporal/size distributions but currently require manual tuning to achieve cost targets; this feature automates initial defaults and provides a safe canary rollout path. What this PR does: 1) a new heuristic_mapper component (Python) that ingests tenant signatures (request size histogram, cold/hot percentiles, token distribution) and produces ranked candidate profiles for batch_size, kv_cache_policy, and quant_profile with estimated unit-econ deltas; 2) a lightweight estimator endpoint in the optimize API that returns recommended defaults and confidence scores; 3) telemetry collectors (Go) to compactly record prefill and warm-start traces used by the mapper; 4) a simulation harness and smoke CLI for dry-runs against tenant traces; 5) integration with rollout policies so recommendations can be applied as canary updates for Dedicated and Private deployments; 6) docs and operator runbook describing safe thresholds and rollback actions. Safety and limitations: mapper is conservative by default (prefers smaller batches if confidence is low), records all decisions for auditing, and exposes "cost_sensitivity" and "latency_slo" knobs for tenant overrides. Testing: unit tests for mapper heuristics, integration test of estimator endpoint against synthetic traces, and a perf smoke that measures latency/regression at 95th percentile before merging. Migration: no breaking API changes, opt-in flag enable_prefill_mapper=false in config for existing installs. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-8274), [x] unit tests added, [x] integration smoke passing, [x] docs updated, [x] telemetry schema version bumped. Backwards impact: none expected. Rollout: staged canary to 5 tenants, monitor unit-econ and latency for 72h before full deploy.

release_notes: Adds a prefill heuristic mapper that generates tenant-specific batching, caching, and quantization defaults with an estimator API and safe canary rollout. Improves out-of-box cost profiles for rent-a-tenant use cases and provides operator runbook for safe deployment.
